12+ Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2D)

Action

Run Time: 2 HRS 05 MINS Language: English Subtitle(s): Arabic

Story: It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

Cast & Crew: Tom Holland, Zendaya , Jacob Batalon, Sadie Sink

Director: NA
